answer: The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The mesa assignment is published and falcon records each panel. Shards are assigned from the crystal graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4920 identities would post 3375 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
